description.text: 看你会不会独立点出问题、分析原因、提出办法并收住。
Can you present the problem, analyse causes, propose solutions, and close?

name.text: A Full Chart Description, Write it all

description.text: 看你会不会独立描述图表：改写题目、总述、对比，不表态。
Can you describe the chart: paraphrase, overview, comparison, no opinion?
过关：独立写成图表描述，总述和对比都要有，不表态。
Checkpoint: describe the chart with overview and comparison, and no opinion.
过关：独立写成立场议论文，论证和让步反驳都要有。
Checkpoint: write a position essay with argument and a concession-rebuttal.
过关：独立写成讨论文，双方看法和你的判断都要有。
Checkpoint: discuss both views and give your own judgement.

name.text: An Advantages and Disadvantages Essay, Checkpoint

description.text: 过关：独立写成利弊文，对照后要落下判断。
Checkpoint: write advantages and disadvantages and then conclude.

name.text: A Problem and Solution Essay, Checkpoint

description.text: 过关：独立写成问题解决文，原因和办法都要有。
Checkpoint: present the problem, causes, and solutions, on your own.
过关：独立把题目两问都答清，并收住全文。
Checkpoint: answer both questions in the prompt and close the essay.

name.text: A Full Chart Description, C1 Checkpoint

description.text: 过关：按 C1 独立写图表，总述对比清楚，不表态。
Checkpoint at C1: describe the chart with a clear overview and comparison, and no opinion.
过关：立场要稳，论证展开，让步反驳也要写透。
Checkpoint at C1: hold a clear position, develop the argument, and write the concession-rebuttal through.
过关：双方都写充分，最后判断不能含糊。
Checkpoint at C1: treat both views fully, then give an unambiguous judgement.

name.text: An Advantages and Disadvantages Essay, C1 Checkpoint

description.text: 过关：利弊对照要细，收尾判断要落得住。
Checkpoint at C1: weigh advantages and disadvantages in detail, then land a firm close.

name.text: A Problem and Solution Essay, C1 Checkpoint

description.text: 过关：问题和办法都展开，不能只点到为止。
Checkpoint at C1: develop both the problem and the solutions, not just name them.

name.text: A Two-Part Question Essay, C1 Checkpoint

description.text: 过关：两问都答深，前后要收成一篇。
Checkpoint at C1: answer both questions in depth and make the piece hold together.
过关：正式信语气稳，三要点写完整。
Checkpoint at C1: keep a steady formal tone and cover all three points.
过关：报告层次清楚，依据和结论都要有。
Checkpoint at C1: keep the report clearly staged, with evidence and a conclusion.

name.text: A Very Short Letter, Write the close first

description.text: 来意已有，看你会不会给这封超短书信收一句，并写上称呼落款。
The purpose is given; can you close this short letter, with greeting and sign-off?

name.text: A Very Short Letter, Write it all

description.text: 看你会不会自己说来意、收一句，并写上称呼落款。
Can you state why you are writing, close, and add greeting and sign-off?
过关：独立写完超短书信，称呼落款也要有。
Checkpoint: write the short letter on your own, with greeting and sign-off.

name.text: A Short Notice, Write the time and place

description.text: 通告的事已有，看你会不会补上时间和地点。
The event is given; can you add the time and place?

name.text: A Short Notice, Write it all

description.text: 看你会不会自己说清是什么通告、时间地点，并加一句欢迎。
Can you say what the notice is about, give the time and place, and add a welcome, on your own?
过关：独立写完一则小通告，标题落款也要有。
Checkpoint: write a short notice on your own, with title and sign-off.

name.text: A Message Note, Write the details

description.text: 来意和收尾已有，看你会不会把时间、地点和要做的事写清。
The purpose and close are given; can you write the time, place and what to do?

name.text: A Message Note, Write it all

description.text: 看你会不会自己说来意、写清信息，并提出请求。
Can you say why you are writing, give the details, and make a request, on your own?
过关：独立写完一张留言条，称呼署名也要有。
Checkpoint: write a message note on your own, with greeting and signature.

name.text: A Short Talk, Give one point

description.text: 开场和收尾已有，看你会不会把中间一点内容讲清。
The opening and close are given; can you make the middle point clear?

name.text: A Short Talk, Write it all

description.text: 看你会不会自己开场、讲清内容，并致谢收尾。
Can you open, make your points, and close with thanks, on your own?
过关：独立写完一篇小发言，开场致谢也要有。
Checkpoint: write a short talk on your own, with opening and thanks.

name.text: A Short News Report, Tell what happened

description.text: 导语和结果已有，看你会不会把经过按顺序写清。
The lead and result are given; can you tell what happened in order?

name.text: A Short News Report, Write it all

description.text: 看你会不会自己写导语、经过和结果，并起一个标题。
Can you write the lead, what happened and the result, and add a headline, on your own?
过关：独立写完一篇小报道，标题也要有。
Checkpoint: write a short news report on your own, with a headline.
背景和呼吁已有，看你会不会把为什么要这样做讲清并举例。
The background and call are given; can you explain why and give examples?
看你会不会自己说明背景、讲清理由和做法，并发出呼吁。
Can you state the background, give reasons and steps, and call to action, on your own?
过关：独立写完一份倡议书，标题称呼落款也要有。
Checkpoint: write a proposal on your own, with title, greeting and sign-off.

name.text: Snap One Sentence from a Picture

description.text: 把你写的一句话拍下来，或画一张图并写上一句。
Take a photo of the sentence you wrote, or draw a picture and write one sentence.

name.text: Say a Few Sentences from a Picture

description.text: 看你会不会用两三句英语说出图上有什么，并加一个细节。
Can you say in two or three sentences what is in the picture and add a detail?

name.text: Record a Few Sentences from a Picture

description.text: 对着图拍一段视频，用两三句英语说出图上有什么。
Record a short video saying in two or three sentences what is in the picture.

name.text: Snap a Few Sentences from a Picture

description.text: 把你写的两三句话拍下来，或画一张图并写上几句。
Take a photo of the two or three sentences you wrote, or draw a picture and write a few sentences.

name.text: One Sentence from a Picture, A1 Checkpoint

description.text: 过关：考场上独立完成一篇看图写一句。
Checkpoint: write one sentence from a picture on your own under exam conditions.

Checkpoint: write a simple chart description on your own under exam conditions.

Checkpoint: write a full introduction on your own under exam conditions.
